patterns.query_template: The catalogue match must be by the exact author name "Lena Orr" and titled exactly "The Copper Gate". Keep works rated at least 4, then sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: A fully bound bibliographic intersection and inclusive record-rating floor are independent supported predicates; sorting presents their intersection without inferring a catalogue association.

patterns.query_template: Build a reading shelf from category "{SUBJECT}". Its creator filter is by the exact name "Lena Orr"; delivery is online only. Sort the surviving titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The thematic shelf, creator, online-only delivery and title ordering each have a separate purpose. No inventory action is implied by staff context.

patterns.query_template: For category "{SUBJECT}", retain a rating of 3.5 or greater. Exclude the whole word "solutions" from searchable text. Short explanations are preferable, with longer discussions acceptable. Sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The text-wide solutions exclusion is distinct from a canonical category negative. Longer discussions remain eligible because short explanations are advisory.

patterns.query_template: A reading-list entry must be by the exact author name "Lena Orr", titled exactly "The Copper Gate", and carry category "{SUBJECT_TYPO}". Exclude works tagged "Fiction".
patterns.semantic_justification: The explicit category typo has one supplied canonical spelling repair. Fiction is an independently owned negative tag; author/title strings establish no category conflict.

patterns.query_template: The work is titled exactly "A Glass Compass". Its rating must reach 4. Exclude works tagged "Fictoin". Advanced analyses are preferred; simpler accounts are acceptable.
patterns.semantic_justification: Fictoin uniquely repairs to the canonical Fiction tag in every supplied scope. The advanced-treatment preference never becomes a hard field.

patterns.query_template: Assemble a bibliography by the exact author name "Lena Orr" under subject "{REPAIR_TYPO}". Exclude the whole word "workbook" from searchable text. Short summaries would help but are optional. Sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The explicit subject typo uniquely repairs against the scope canonical list. Bibliography creator, broad text exclusion and title order are resolved; summary length remains soft.

patterns.query_template: The slots "by" and "titled" must take the two exact strings "Lena Orr" and "A Glass Compass", one string per slot. Their assignment is still undecided. Require a rating of at least 4. Beginner explanations are preferred but optional.
patterns.semantic_justification: Two literal values are known but their mandatory author/title assignment is expressly undecided. Name-like appearance cannot resolve ownership; the rating floor is resolved.

patterns.query_template: Use works by the exact author name "Lena Orr", online only, and sort titles A to Z. The instruction "exclude the whole word abridged from searchable text" has unsettled status: it could be mandatory or advisory, and that choice is pending.
patterns.semantic_justification: The negative operand is known, but mandatory/advisory ownership is unresolved. Either applying or dropping its filter would settle that open choice without authorization.

patterns.query_template: Target works titled exactly "The Copper Gate". One mandatory category must be chosen between "{SUBJECT}" and "{ALTERNATIVE}"; that single choice remains pending. Research discussions are an optional preference. Sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The one mandatory canonical operand has two candidates and no chosen value. A pending single choice does not license a union or an invented association.

patterns.query_template: Find works by [empty required creator value]. The rating ceiling is 4, inclusive. Exclude the whole word "abridged" from searchable text, and sort titles A to Z. The creator value is intentionally unfilled.
patterns.semantic_justification: The required creator field is empty rather than ambiguous between candidates. Neither the resolved numeric ceiling nor text exclusion can substitute for it.

patterns.query_template: The required title box reads titled "" and is empty. The remaining checks are category "{SUBJECT}", online only, and exclude works tagged "Fiction". Keep the empty title box mandatory.
patterns.semantic_justification: An explicitly empty required title is missing input. Its shelf membership and Fiction exclusion are both resolved and need no inferred catalogue fact.

patterns.query_template: Choose works by the exact author name "Lena Orr", online only. A minimum rating is mandatory, but its numeric box is empty. Short explanations are optional. Sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: Minimum gives the comparison direction but no numeric endpoint. No threshold is invented; creator, delivery, soft reading style and ordering are definite.
absence_notes: rating_min_exclusive is omitted because no endpoint is instantiated; inclusive minimum semantics remain in the query.

patterns.query_template: Form an exclusive-membership partition for subject "{SUBJECT}" and subject "{ALTERNATIVE}": a work qualifies precisely when it bears one of those two tags; doubly tagged and untagged works fail. Restrict to works by the exact author name "Lena Orr", require rating at least 4, and sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The explicit membership truth table is XOR, with both operands resolved. Replacing it with an ordinary subject union or intersection would change the strict operation.
absence_notes: subjects scalar omitted: no supported list conjunction is asserted in place of XOR.

patterns.query_template: For works by the exact author name "Lena Orr", titled exactly "The Copper Gate", require online only. Exclude a work precisely when "amber" and "ledger" occur at most two words apart in searchable text. This proximity rule is strict. Short introductions are optional.
patterns.semantic_justification: A bounded word-proximity relation is an unsupported strict text operation. Neither operand is silently converted into an independent forbidden word.
absence_notes: exclude_terms omitted: independent word exclusions would change the proximity predicate.

patterns.query_template: Use online only within subject "{SUBJECT}". Admit a work only when its creator has an average rating of at least 4 across every work credited to that creator. The creator-wide average is a strict condition. Advanced accounts are preferable but optional. Sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The mandatory rating threshold targets an aggregate over a creator corpus, rather than the selected record. The contract does not enforce this cross-record aggregation, and record rating_min would be false gold.
absence_notes: rating_min/rating_max omitted: no per-record bound is requested.

patterns.query_template: Use works titled exactly "The Copper Gate", online only. Apply both rating checks simultaneously: a minimum of 4 inclusive and a maximum of 3 inclusive. Sort titles A to Z.
patterns.semantic_justification: The simultaneous closed interval [4,3] is empty. Both resolved bounds remain in hard gold; catalogue contents cannot resolve their incompatibility.

patterns.query_template: Find works by the exact author name "Lena Orr". Require category "{SUBJECT}" and exclude works tagged "{SUBJECT}"; both membership checks are mandatory. Short introductions are an optional preference.
patterns.semantic_justification: The same canonical membership is required and forbidden. The optional introductory-treatment preference cannot reconcile those opposed mandatory predicates.

patterns.query_template: For works titled exactly "The Copper Gate", use online only and sort titles A to Z. Two mandatory checks use the identical searchable-text domain: include a match of the whole word "atlas", and exclude a match of the whole word "atlas". Short explanations are merely preferred.
patterns.semantic_justification: Opposed whole-word atlas predicates over the identical domain cannot both hold. This definite semantic contradiction is preserved even though the positive predicate has no supplied scalar equivalent.

construction_rules: Eighteen genuinely revised semantic patterns across five scopes; shared groups are disclosed, not ninety independent grammars.
Each detected structural feature has a meaningful supported, unresolved, contradictory or unsupported requested operation; no inert padding.
Author/title strings do not establish bibliography facts. Canonical repairs use supplied per-scope subject lists and source-backed notices.
Three ambiguity families cover association, hard/advisory ownership and operand choice; incomplete families cover creator, title and numeric endpoint.
Unsupported families cover XOR membership, negative proximity and creator-wide aggregate rating, rather than false scalar replacements.
Contradiction families cover a reversed closed interval, opposed canonical membership and identical-domain opposed text predicates.
Canonical scalar fields and exclusive-format lists follow supplied coordinator metadata; unknown operands remain UNRESOLVED and absent fields are explicit.
No labels derive from a parser or outcomes. All desired strata were judged feasible; fresh independent review is still required.
